summary: Feature request to expose the CONTINUE_AS_NEW_VERSIONING_BEHAVIOR_USE_RAMPING_VERSION constant as a ContinueAsNewVersioningBehavior option across Temporal SDKs, enabling users to access advanced versioning strategies.
userImpact: SDK users can now use the ramping version behavior directly through standardized ContinueAsNewVersioningBehavior interfaces instead of workarounds or lower-level access.
proposedFix: Expose CONTINUE_AS_NEW_VERSIONING_BEHAVIOR_USE_RAMPING_VERSION as a ContinueAsNewVersioningBehavior enum option in all Temporal SDKs.
resolutionDetails: Feature was implemented across multiple SDKs with checkmarks indicating completion in Go, TypeScript, Python, .NET, and Ruby; pending in Java, Rust, PHP, and Temporal CLI.
